messages:
liz: Heads up — ACME (legal procurement) flagged three must-haves for us to close the deal: Terraform provider, Marketplace listing, and SCIM SSO with provisioning. Sales says procurement won't sign without Marketplace presence.

devin: Added to intake form. What ETA are they expecting?

jordan-sales: They want GA in 8 weeks. Pilot in 4. They're willing to pay for integration work (SOW) — budget available.

samir: Clarify SCIM: do they need group sync + SCIM push for users? Any custom attrs?

jordan-sales: Need users + groups + role mapping. Custom attr: acct_tier. SCIM must support group->role mapping. Also enforce email domains on create.

maria-pm: Proposed triage:
- MVP: Terraform provider (create/resource read/delete), Marketplace listing (basic listing + onboarding doc), SCIM user create + group sync (no custom attrs).
- Stretch: role mapping, acct_tier, org-level admin UI, audited SCIM logs
- Acceptance: E2E e2e test with ACME sandbox, doc + SSO setup guide, pricing SOW.

devin: Can we get eng estimate for MVP? Rough ballpark sprints? 

samir: MVP dev: ~3 sprints (1 infra + 2 feature) + 1 QA sprint. Marketplace listing: 1 sprint for packaging + docs. SCIM infra: 2 sprints if we reuse existing SCIM handler; else +1.

liz: So total ~5-6 sprints. With 8-week customer timeline that's tight but possible if we prioritize and staff. Recommend we offer a paid SOW for accelerated delivery.

maria-pm: Prioritization: tag as high-touch enterprise-integration and backlog labels: integ/terraform, integ/marketplace, integ/sso, customer:acme, revenue:paid-sow. Also request product approval for dedicated FE time for docs.

devin: I'll create intake issue and add labels. What should the owner field be?

maria-pm: Owner = samir (eng lead) + liz (sales PM) as sponsor.

samir: Notes for implementation:
```
resource "redwood_inference_integration" "acme_terraform" {
  name = "acme"
  enable_scim = true
}
```
Need provider level auth flow, token rotation, and example module in repo.

eng-bot: ticket #INT-4827 created: https://redwoodjira/INT-4827 — labels applied.

liz: Ping if anything blocks. Jordan will coordinate legal and provide ACME's SCIM spec.

jordan-sales: Sharing spec now: link to docs + sample SCIM JSON.

maria-pm: Launch criteria checklist:
- Core features implemented (Terraform + Marketplace + SCIM user create)
- ACME sandbox test pass
- Docs and onboarding playbook
- SOW signed or clear commercial path
- Tags and telemetry instrumented

devin: I'll add checklist to the intake issue.

samir: If ACME wants role mapping in MVP we'll need an extra sprint. Confirm final scope by EOD tomorrow.

liz: Thx team. I'll push for SOW to buy time. :thumbsup:

inc-bot: Deployment freeze reminder — none scheduled for next 2 weeks.

jordan-sales: I'll follow up with ACME timeline and escalate if they ask for acceleration.

maria-pm: Moving this to triage board and assigning story points after scoping session.
